content:
MINISFORUM Elite Mini M2 Air-304 is a barebone mini PC powered by an Intel Core 3 304 Wildcat Lake penta-core processor with a DDR5 SO-DIMM slot and an M.2 PCIe Gen4 x4 socket for NVMe SSD storage. There’s currently a limited number of Wildcat Lake mini PCs which you can purchase or pre-order, such as the Beelink EQi Wildcat Lake and the BOSGAME E6 Eco. These are ready to use out of the box with memory, storage, and Windows 11 pre-loaded. The MINISFORUM model is the first Wildcat Lake barebone mini PC we’ve seen, where users can bring their own memory, storage, and OS. MINISFORUM Elite Mini M2 Air-304 specifications: SoC – Intel Core 3 304 “Wildcat Lake” 5-core CPU – 1x P-core @ 1.5/4.3 GHz (Turbo) + 4x LPE-cores @ 1.4/3.3 GHz (Turbo) Cache – 6MB L3 cache GPU – 1-core Intel Xe3 Graphics @ 2.3 GHz (9 TOPS) [...]
